name: Eyes & light

secondary.label: Seconds after stepping out of the sun

outputs.label: Light reaching the back of the eye

overlay.caption: bright light → iris squeezes the pupil small · dim light → pupil opens wide

does: Shows pupils shrinking as the light gets brighter and widening as it dims
Shows the light reaching the back of the eye staying much steadier than the light outside
Shows pupils finishing their change within a few seconds
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Include the slower adjustment of the light-sensing cells themselves (see The Dark Cinema)
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: Never look straight at the sun, even with small pupils — and tell an adult if bright light ever hurts your eyes.
